svg.title: Maskr
svg.desc: An on-device privacy guard that checks prompts and attachments for sensitive data before they reach AI chatbots. Published on the Chrome Web Store. Combines local detection, masking, and image redaction for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot. Stack: JavaScript · Manifest V3 · ONNX Runtime Web · On-device inference

g.text: Local detection, masking, and attachment redaction.
JavaScript · Manifest V3 · ONNX Runtime Web
